events.text:
Compact sewing organizer complete — verified clear of collisions.

**Build:** 3-cell core plus center (4 bases). Provides varied divided storage for sewing notions:
- Center and north (-1,0,0 and 0,0,0): 2-compartment full-depth bins for larger items (scissors, tape measures, pin cushions)
- South & upper (0,-1,0 and 0,1,0): 3-compartment bins for small notions (buttons, bobbins, needles, thread)

All bins are drop-in and interchangeable.
